title: Algeria Standardized Precipitation Index SPI (CHIRPS v3.0), 1981–2026: national, wilaya and commune
title_fr: Indice de précipitations normalisé SPI pour l'Algérie (CHIRPS v3.0)
description: Standardized Precipitation Index at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, monthly 1981-01 to 2026-10, for Algeria, its 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes. Computed by AEO from the area-mean monthly precipitation of the AEO CHIRPS v3.0 product, with a gamma distribution fitted per calendar month on 1991–2020.
purpose: Monitor meteorological drought (rainfall deficits) in Algeria at several timescales; complements SPEI, which also accounts for evaporative demand.

spatial_extent.description: Algeria (AEO boundaries 2026-11-20): 1 country, 69 wilayas, 1,541 communes. Tables by administrative unit; no grid maps.

temporal_extent.description: Monthly 1981-01 to 2026-10; updated when the AEO precipitation product is updated. Calibration 1991–2020.

processing: For each unit, monthly precipitation is accumulated over 1, 3, 6 and 12 months. For each calendar month a gamma distribution is fitted to the positive 1991–2020 accumulations with unbiased probability-weighted moments (Hosking PELGAM); zero accumulations use the mixed distribution H = q + (1−q)G. SPI = Φ⁻¹(H), clipped to ±3.09. Not computed for a calendar month with fewer than 10 positive reference accumulations.
validation: tests/python/test_spi.py: agreement with R SPEI 1.8.1 spi() (Gamma, ub-pwm, reference 1991–2020) within 1e-6 on six wilaya series, wherever the reference sample has no zero accumulations (R 1.8.1 does not apply the zero probability). Product QC: SPI-3 over 1991–2020 has mean within ±0.03 and standard deviation 0.93–1.04 in non-arid units.
limitations: SPI measures rainfall anomalies only; it ignores evaporative demand (use SPEI for the water balance).
In arid units (normal below 100 mm/year; 11 wilayas, 93 communes) rainfall is rare, many calendar months cannot be fitted and SPI is unstable; these units are flagged.
Commune values rest on few CHIRPS cells for small communes; CHIRPS has few gauges in the Sahara.
Computed on the unit-mean precipitation, not as the mean of cell-level SPI.

access.label: Wilayas — latest SPI and drought frequency (CSV)

algeria_notes: In the north (Tell and High Plateaux) SPI-3 and SPI-6 follow the agricultural season; SPI-12 shows multi-year droughts such as 2020–2024.

verification.notes: Computed from the published AEO precipitation product; see PROVENANCE.json.
